configuration.md.purpose: Loads and validates the job, app, and LLM configuration schemas that every other module reads.
configuration.md.title: Amsha Configuration

crew-forge.md.purpose: Turns crew definitions into runnable CrewAI crews and flows, and executes them.
crew-forge.md.title: Amsha Crew Forge

crew-monitor.md.purpose: Observes running crews — resource usage, event lifecycle, per-agent contribution, and Excel reporting.
crew-monitor.md.title: Amsha Crew Monitor

execution-runtime.md.purpose: Submits work to a bounded thread pool and returns a cancellable, awaitable handle.
execution-runtime.md.title: Amsha Execution Runtime

execution-state.md.purpose: Models the lifecycle of a single run and persists it through an injected state repository.
execution-state.md.title: Amsha Execution State

llm-factory.md.purpose: Builds LLM instances for any provider from one configuration, with purpose profiles for creative versus evaluation work.
llm-factory.md.title: Amsha LLM Factory

output-process.md.purpose: Post-processes structured crew output — currently JSON cleaning only; the evaluation and validation subpackages are unbuilt stubs.
output-process.md.title: Amsha Output Processing

utils.md.purpose: Small format helpers for JSON, YAML, and UTF-8 handling, shared across modules.
utils.md.title: Amsha Utils
